findings.summary: Stop-hook path (gatherStopContext, src/stop-reminder.ts:399) has no guard: rewiring it to the old tags-only rule turns nothing red (mutation M6 survived). Wiring is correct today; missing test, not a bug.

countsAsSessionHandoff ignores supersession while latestHandoff excludes superseded ids (src/engine.ts:652), so its 'cannot drift from latestHandoff' comment overclaims. Unreachable via vfkb writes (supersede() refuses non-decisions, src/engine.ts:386); reachable only with hand-edited or foreign rows. Same for a fresh handoff with no created.
test/sessionend-floor.test.ts:252 is named '...is the pin...' but asserts only autoHandoff:false; nothing checks the pin.
B1 prompt line says 'no handoff/next entry' to a session holding a decision tagged handoff (src/prompt-nudge.ts:148); the following type=fact line mostly covers it.

ruledOut: countsAsSessionHandoff never throws on malformed rows (null, string, number, array, bad tags/validity/zone/provenance): hooks fail open
mixed-type tags: normalizeEntry resets them, agreeing with latestHandoff
no import cycle: validate.ts imports only zod + types; storage.ts already imported it
same 'today' default on both sides; no caller overrides it
newEntriesSinceHead keeps one row per id (newest updated) and drops deleted, so no duplicate-row ambiguity
hooks pass raw JSON.parse rows, the same input materialize feeds normalizeEntry
the archived-in-session test matches how engine update paths re-append
vfkb import drops created, so an imported handoff cannot dodge the pin with an old timestamp
no AI attribution, correct vilosource identity on both commits
